title: UX/UI Designer
description:
UI/UX Designer  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years  
**Location:** Ahmedabad, India  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Company:** Techrays Labs Pvt. Ltd.

About the Role  
We’re looking for a **UI/UX Designer** who enjoys solving real problems through thoughtful, usable, and accessible digital experiences.  
At Techrays Labs, design goes beyond visual aesthetics. You’ll work on **web and mobile products for clients across the US, Australia, Europe, and Canada**, contributing to products that are used by real people.  
We follow a **human-centered and accessibility-first approach**, with usability, consistency, and WCAG principles playing an important role in our design process.

What You’ll Do

* Understand business requirements, user needs, and project objectives.
* Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI designs.
* Design responsive experiences for **web, tablet, and mobile**.
* Develop clean, intuitive, and consistent interfaces across different products.
* Apply **user-centered design principles** to solve usability problems.
* Follow accessibility best practices and **WCAG guidelines** while designing interfaces.
* Create and maintain design systems, reusable components, and UI patterns.
* Work closely with developers to ensure accurate design implementation.
* Prepare detailed design specifications and assets for developer handoff.
* Review implemented designs and identify visual or usability inconsistencies.
* Participate in design discussions, reviews, and client/project meetings when required.
* Stay updated with current UI/UX trends, accessibility standards, and emerging design practices.

Required Skills

* Strong understanding of **UI/UX design principles and processes**.
* Good knowledge of **user-centered design and usability principles**.
* Experience creating **wireframes, user flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs**.
* Strong understanding of **responsive web and mobile design**.
* Good knowledge of **typography, color, spacing, layout, visual hierarchy, and interaction design**.
* Understanding of **WCAG and accessibility-first design**.
* Ability to create reusable components and work with **design systems**.
* Basic understanding of how web and mobile interfaces are developed.
* Ability to communicate design decisions clearly and collaborate with developers.
* Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work on multiple projects and adapt to different industries and client requirements.

Tools & Technologies  
**Required:**

* **Figma** – UI design, wireframing, prototyping, components, and design systems
* **Figma Make** – AI Based workflow assistance
* **Adobe Creative Cloud/Adobe Express** – Basic image and graphic editing
* **Figma Dev Mode** – Developer handoff and design specifications
* Familiarity with **HTML & CSS**
* **Understanding of WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA**

**Good to Have:**

* Experience with **Adobe XD**
* Basic understanding of **Material UI, Bootstrap, or other UI frameworks**
* Familiarity with accessibility testing tools such as **WAVE, axe DevTools, or Lighthouse**
* Familiarity with **Jira, ClickUp, Trello, or similar project management tools**
* Experience working with **WordPress or other CMS platforms**

What We’re Looking For

* A designer who thinks about **why** something should be designed a certain way, not just how it looks.
* Someone who can balance **user needs, business goals, and technical constraints**.
* Someone who pays attention to accessibility, usability, and small interaction details.
* A collaborative team player who is comfortable receiving and giving constructive feedback.
* Someone curious about learning, experimenting, and improving their design process.
* A designer who can take ownership of their work and communicate effectively with the team.
